instructions.scope: Offline historical description of configured holdings; no simulation, pricing, curve or local-vol calibration. Reference products and options do not enter portfolio weights.
instructions.annualization: Sample standard deviation uses ddof=1 and annual volatility uses sqrt(periods_per_year). Annual mean is daily mean times periods_per_year: arithmetic for simple returns, additive log growth for log returns; neither is CAGR. CAGR and percentage drawdown use the shared wealth path and calendar elapsed years.
instructions.basis: Adjusted returns approximate reinvested distributions. Never add dividends again. Price-only histories remain explicitly labelled.
instructions.portfolio: Initial weights from portfolio.json are applied once at the first common observed price date. Buy-and-hold sleeve weights then drift. All active holdings must share a currency and a compatible return meaning. No FX conversion or rebalancing.
instructions.gaps: Do not fill prices. Daily dependence requires identical return start and end dates. Gaps break rolling windows; full-path metrics are withheld across missing/excluded intervals.
instructions.stress: Windows are illustrative comparisons, not official crisis boundaries. Their actual data coverage and sample count are reported. No return beginning before a window is included.
instructions.distribution: Normal and Student-t fits describe historical daily returns only. Student-t scale is not its standard deviation. No Student-t wealth paths are simulated.
instructions.minimum_observations: Smaller samples retain mathematically defined metrics but are labelled insufficient_history; undefined metrics remain null.
instructions.plots: Separate simple/log PNG diagnostics use a non-interactive backend. Wealth and drawdown charts are shared. Log returns shown times 100 are labelled log-return units, not percentage investment gains.
instructions.returns: Analyse simple P_t/P_previous-1 and log log1p(simple) returns over exactly the same valid intervals. All return-dependent tables are labelled return_type. Portfolio log returns come from portfolio wealth, never a weighted sum of asset log returns.
